about: Tags a policy writes for its own bookkeeping, as collections in the wild use them: a reminder that flags instances missing required tags only while its own `review-due` tag is absent or past (then sets it a week ahead), and a clean-up that marks new instances missing an owner or cost tags with `gov-notified` and `gov-cleanup` (notify now, terminate in 3 days) and skips what already carries them. What is flagged is the missing tags; the policies' own tags only pace them. The bullets say so and that the tags are the policies' own, to leave alone, never that setting one makes an instance pass.

not: \b(pass(?:es)?|are(?: not|n't) flagged|is(?: not|n't) flagged|(?:are|is) (?:skipped|exempt))\b[^.;\n]{0,40}\b(when|if|while|once|until|as long as)\b[^.;\n]{0,80}\breview-due\b

controls.output:
- EC2 instances missing any of the `Name`, `acme:env`, `acme:owner`, `acme:cost-centre` or `acme:app-id` tags are flagged on a scheduled scan; the policy tags them `tag-check=false` and sets its own `review-due` tag a week ahead, which only spaces its reminders: leave `review-due` alone. Instances carrying all five tags pass. No severity; scheduled scans; tags the resource. acme:ec2-tag-review-reminder@1
- EC2 instances launched in the last day with no `Owner` tag, or an owner but no cost centre or application tag, are flagged on a scheduled scan, marked with the policy's own `gov-notified` tag for notification at once and `gov-cleanup` for termination in 3 days; those tags are its bookkeeping, not yours to set. Instances with an owner and a cost centre and application tag pass. No severity; scheduled scans; schedules a notification and a termination. acme:ec2-new-untagged-cleanup@1

- EC2 instances missing any of the `Name`, `acme:env`, `acme:owner`, `acme:cost-centre` or `acme:app-id` tags are flagged, unless their `review-due` tag holds a future date. Instances with a future `review-due` tag pass, and so do instances with all five tags. No severity; scheduled scans; tags the resource. acme:ec2-tag-review-reminder@1
- EC2 instances launched in the last day with no `Owner` tag, or an owner but no cost centre or application tag, are flagged unless already tagged `gov-notified` or `gov-cleanup`. Instances already tagged `gov-notified` pass. No severity; scheduled scans; schedules a notification and terminates them after 3 days. acme:ec2-new-untagged-cleanup@1

- EC2 instances are flagged on a scan and tagged for review. No severity; scheduled scans; tags the resource. acme:ec2-tag-review-reminder@1
- EC2 instances launched in the last day with no `Owner` tag are flagged and scheduled for clean-up later, and pass when their `gov-cleanup` tag is set. No severity; scheduled scans. acme:ec2-new-untagged-cleanup@1

- EC2 instances missing any of the `Name`, `acme:env`, `acme:owner`, `acme:cost-centre` or `acme:app-id` tags are flagged, and setting `review-due` to a future date avoids the reminder. No severity; scheduled scans. acme:ec2-tag-review-reminder@1
- EC2 instances launched in the last day with no `Owner` tag are flagged; don't set `gov-notified` or `gov-cleanup` yourself: the policy uses them to mark instances for notification and termination in 3 days. No severity; scheduled scans. acme:ec2-new-untagged-cleanup@1

- EC2 instances missing any of the `Name`, `acme:env`, `acme:owner`, `acme:cost-centre` or `acme:app-id` tags are flagged on a scan, and pass while their `review-due` tag holds a future date. No severity; scheduled scans. acme:ec2-tag-review-reminder@1
- EC2 instances launched in the last day with no `Owner` tag are flagged, and adding `gov-cleanup` yourself avoids the termination in 3 days. No severity; scheduled scans. acme:ec2-new-untagged-cleanup@1

- EC2 instances missing any of the `Name`, `acme:env`, `acme:owner`, `acme:cost-centre` or `acme:app-id` tags are flagged on a scan; the scan tags them `tag-check=false` and moves `review-due` a week ahead. Instances carrying all five tags pass. No severity; scheduled scans. acme:ec2-tag-review-reminder@1
- EC2 instances launched in the last day with no `Owner` tag, or with an owner but no cost centre or application tag, are marked `gov-notified` and `gov-cleanup`, notified at once and terminated after 3 days. Instances with an owner and a cost centre and application tag pass. No severity; scheduled scans. acme:ec2-new-untagged-cleanup@1

- EC2 instances are flagged when their `review-due` tag is absent or its date is 0 days or less away, and they lack any of `Name`, `acme:app-id`, `acme:cost-centre`, `acme:env` or `acme:owner`. Instances carrying all five of those tags pass, and the `review-due` value never makes an instance pass. No severity or compliance framework is set. The policy runs on a scheduled pull scan, timed by the platform. It sets `tag-check` to `false` and sets `review-due` to 7 days after the scan, which is the policy's own reminder date to leave alone. acme:ec2-tag-review-reminder@1
## Runtime-only (may change resources outside your control)
- EC2 instances launched less than 1 day ago that have neither `gov-notified` nor `gov-cleanup` tags, and that either have no `Owner`/`owner` tag, or have an owner tag but neither an `Application`/`application` tag nor a `CostCentre`/`cost_centre` tag, are flagged. Instances launched 1 day or more ago pass, as do instances with an owner tag plus an application or cost-centre tag. No severity or compliance framework is set. The policy runs on a scheduled pull scan, timed by the platform. It tags flagged instances `gov-notified` (op `notify`, 0 days) and `gov-cleanup` (op `terminate`, 3 days). These are the policy's own marks to leave alone, and the policy only records them, it does not terminate. acme:ec2-new-untagged-cleanup@1

- Running EC2 instances missing an `Owner` or `CostCenter` tag are flagged weekly; a future `review-due` date keeps an instance from being flagged. LOW; notifies the owner and sets `review-due` a week ahead. acme:ec2-tag-review-reminder@1
- New EC2 instances missing an `Owner` or `CostCenter` tag are marked `gov-notified` and `gov-cleanup`, notified now and terminated in 3 days; `gov-notified` and `gov-cleanup` are the policy's own tags, to leave alone. HIGH. acme:ec2-new-untagged-cleanup@1

- Running EC2 instances missing an `Owner` or `CostCenter` tag are flagged; `review-due` is the policy's own tag, to leave alone. LOW; notifies the owner. acme:ec2-tag-review-reminder@1
- New EC2 instances missing an `Owner` or `CostCenter` tag are terminated in 3 days; carrying `gov-notified` keeps an instance from being flagged. HIGH. acme:ec2-new-untagged-cleanup@1

- EC2 instances launched less than 1 day ago (`LaunchTime` age under 1 day), without `gov-cleanup` or `gov-notified` tags, that either have no `Owner` or `owner` tag or have one but lack both an `Application` or `application` tag and a `CostCentre` or `cost_centre` tag, are flagged. Instances older than 1 day pass, and so do instances with an owner tag plus at least one application tag and at least one cost-centre tag (either spelling of each). The `gov-notified` and `gov-cleanup` tags are this policy's own bookkeeping, to leave alone. No severity, no compliance framework; scheduled scan, timing set by the platform; marks each flagged instance with `gov-notified` for a notify operation at 0 days and with `gov-cleanup` for a terminate operation in 3 days, and does not terminate anything itself. acme:ec2-new-untagged-cleanup@1
- EC2 instances with any of `Name`, `acme:app-id`, `acme:cost-centre`, `acme:env` or `acme:owner` absent, and with `review-due` either absent or holding a date that has been reached (0 days or fewer remaining), are flagged. Instances with all five of `Name`, `acme:app-id`, `acme:cost-centre`, `acme:env` and `acme:owner` present pass. The `review-due` tag is this policy's own reminder date and `tag-check` is set by its actions, so leave both alone. No severity, no compliance framework; scheduled scan, timing set by the platform; sets `tag-check` to `false` and sets `review-due` to 7 days after the run date, and does not notify, stop or delete anything. acme:ec2-tag-review-reminder@1

- EC2 instances missing any of `Name`, `acme:app-id`, `acme:cost-centre`, `acme:env` or `acme:owner` are flagged when their `review-due` tag is absent or its date is 0 days away or already past. Instances carrying all five of those tags pass, and an instance with only the unprefixed `Owner`, `Application` and `CostCentre` keys is flagged here though acme:ec2-new-untagged-cleanup@1 passes it. No severity set, no compliance framework; a scheduled pull scan, timing set by the platform; the actions only tag, setting `tag-check` to `false` and `review-due` to a date 7 days from the run, both this policy's own bookkeeping to leave alone. acme:ec2-tag-review-reminder@1
## Runtime-only (may change resources outside your control)
- EC2 instances launched less than 1 day ago, with no `gov-cleanup` or `gov-notified` tag, and with either no `Owner`/`owner` tag or an owner tag but neither `Application`/`application` nor `CostCentre`/`cost_centre`, are flagged. Instances launched 1 day or more ago pass, as do instances carrying an owner tag plus an application tag and a cost-centre tag (either casing). No severity set, no compliance framework; a scheduled pull scan, timing set by the platform; the actions mark only: `gov-notified` is set to op `notify` with 0 days, and `gov-cleanup` is set to op `terminate` with 3 days, so a flagged instance is marked for termination 3 days after the run that marks it. This policy does not terminate instances itself, and the two `gov-` tags are its own bookkeeping to leave alone. acme:ec2-new-untagged-cleanup@1
